Customers on file, whether or not they ever received an order.
Distinct customers with a delivered order in the current filter context.

Customers whose last delivered purchase was under 180 days before the reference date 2026-01-01 (the Step 7 inactivity threshold). A snapshot: it does not move with the Date slicer. Inactivity, not churn.
Snapshot count of customers inactive for 180 days or more.

Customers whose FIRST delivered purchase falls inside the selected dates. For 2023 this counts first purchases observed in the data, which includes customers acquired earlier (see DimCustomer[Acquisition_Status]).
Snapshot count of customers with 2 or more delivered orders in total.
Customers with 2 or more delivered orders WITHIN the selected dates - the period version of the measure above.
Share of purchasing customers who ordered more than once.
Purchase frequency in the current context.
Revenue per purchasing customer in the current context.
A customer's (or customer selection's) share of revenue, against all customers with the other slicers still applied.
An RFM segment's share of revenue.
A K-Means cluster's share of revenue.
A category's or product's share of revenue.
A region's share of revenue.

Step 7 historical revenue per customer, summed over the selection.
Step 7 model ESTIMATE of the next 12 months' profit. Always labelled as an estimate and never added to historical value.
Mean estimated 12-month future profit per customer in the selection.
Step 7 illustrative 3-year value (12-month estimate x (1 + r + r²), r = 0.839). Illustrative only - it assumes the observed repeat rate persists.
High historical value AND no delivered purchase for 180+ days (Step 7 flag). 'Potentially at risk', not churned.
Top 20% of customers by historical profit (Step 7 flag).
Customers in the selected segment or cluster (snapshot assignment).
Share of the customer base in this segment or cluster.
Mean days since the last delivered purchase, at the 2026-01-01 reference date.
Mean lifetime delivered orders per customer.
Mean lifetime delivered revenue per customer.
Mean R+F+M score (3-15) of the selected customers.
Revenue per customer within the segment or cluster.
Share of order lines that were Returned or Cancelled.
Distinct products with delivered sales in the current context.
Product rank by revenue, respecting the slicers - used for Top N / Bottom N.
How far a product's margin sits above or below its own category's margin, in points. This is the metric the Bottom-products visual ranks on.
Step 8 model prediction of customer revenue for the target quarter. Test split only.
The matching actual revenue for those same customer-quarters, so predicted and actual are always compared on identical rows.
The previous-quarter baseline the model is judged against.
Mean absolute error per customer-quarter.
Root mean squared error per customer-quarter.
R² over the rows in context. On the full test split this reproduces the Step 8 figure; inside a slicer it is the R² of that subset, which is a different quantity.
Total over- or under-prediction. MAPE is deliberately absent: many customer-quarters have an actual of 0, so a percentage error is undefined for them.
The reported Step 8 / Step 9 metric from the ModelMetrics table; used by the model performance matrix so no metric is ever retyped into a text box.
Actual monthly revenue, 2023-01 to 2025-12. Equals [Total Revenue] by month.
Future forecast, 2026-01 to 2026-06, from the model fitted on all 36 months.
Validation and test forecasts produced without seeing those months - the evidence for the accuracy figures.
Lower bound of the 80% prediction interval.
Upper bound of the 80% prediction interval.
Lower bound of the 95% prediction interval.
Upper bound of the 95% prediction interval.
Width of the 95% interval - it widens with the horizon, which is the honest way to show that a 6-month-out month is less certain than next month.
Number of forecast months shown (6).
Total forecast revenue for the whole 6-month horizon, independent of the Date slicer.
Forecast-total card label in crore / lakh.
